title: Insurance Coverage & Patient Responsibility Payment-Regularity Months
content:
| Patient-payment entries posted on the account fewer than 12 whole calendar months before the handling date | Months added to the new arrangement's term |
|---|---|
| 6 or more | 2 |
| 3 to 5 | 1 |
| 0 to 2 | 0 |

**Schedule note.** Payment-regularity months are added to the term of a new Insurance Coverage & Patient Responsibility payment arrangement according to the patient-payment entries posted on the coverage account fewer than 12 whole calendar months before the handling date: at least 6 entries add 2 months, at least 3 but fewer than 6 add 1 month, and fewer add none.

Footnotes:

1. Each patient-payment entry counts once; a payment applied across two charges appears as two entries.
2. An entry posted 12 whole calendar months before the handling date is outside the window.
3. Hypothetical: 6 entries in the window add 2 months; 5 entries add 1; 2 entries add none.
